name: Trade Confirmation Status 1 Code
definition: Identifies the status of the confirmation.

ALST.name: All Status
ALST.definition: All current status of the trade.

CONF.name: Confirmed
CONF.definition: Trades are confirmed by Central Matching Utility (analogous to virtual matching utility).

DISA.name: Disaccord
DISA.definition: Trade information of the both trading member is unmatched.

EMCN.name: Emergency Confirmed
EMCN.definition: Central Matching Utility (analogous to virtual matching utility) confirms trades in contingency.

MISM.name: Mismatched
MISM.definition: Trade information between Central Matching Utility(analogous to virtual matching utility) and the trading member is mismatched.

SCCN.name: Self Confirmed And Couterparty Not Confirmed
SCCN.definition: Home party has confirmed, but couterparty is unrecognized.

SNCC.name: Self Not Confirmed And Couterparty Confirmed
SNCC.definition: Home party has not confirmed, but couterparty is recognized.

SNCN.name: Self Not Confirmed And Couterparty Not Confirmed
SNCN.definition: Both the two parties are not confirmed.

UNCN.name: Unconfirmed
UNCN.definition: Trades are not confirmed by Central Matching Utility(analogous to virtual matching utility).
